race.description: My Last Hooray For Kosi Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: BOUJEE GOLD (10) finished fifth when resuming at Goulburn two runs back then improved last start but found a couple better over 1425m at Moruya. Close up there and things are no tougher this time. Gets his race. Blinkers come off but they go on to OVERSHOOT (8) who has started twice, running a good third on debut then finishing seventh, beaten 6 lengths, last time over 1200m at Moruya. It might be that those blinkers help now. ISOTROPIC (5) was beaten for early speed and didn't come into contention when sixth over 1300m at Kembla Grange most recently but now finds an easier assignment. BULLECOURT (4) resumed from a spell last start when fifth over 1400m at Nowra. Improved showing expected with added fitness this time.
